newsitem.title: UK: BA continues cut-price cargo promotion.
newsitem.headline: BA continues cut-price cargo promotion.

text.p: British Airway's is continuing until March 2nd many of the cut price rates it was offering in January on its international cargo routes, a BA spokesman said.

The extension of the January special promotion covers 25 North Atlantic, 14 southern region covering the Middle East, east Africa and the Indian sub-continent, one Pacific (Beijing) and 13 European routes.
The special low rates must be booked within 72 hours of carrying and cannot replace existing or permanent bookings, the spokesman added.
As a wholesaling carrier the special deals are aimed at freight forwarders and are for pallet type 5 and 8.
The continuation of the sale for a further month indicates that in January it had been successful in attracting business.

Other carriers have not admitted making similar offers in competition to BA but some industry sources said special lists of cut-price rates had been circulated from at least two other major Europeran carriers.
